name: Doughnut Chart
when_to_pick: Show how one whole splits into parts when the relative SHARE of each part is the story, not its exact value — capital allocation across instruments, where a monthly trading budget goes, win/loss/break-even mix, or risk spread across strategies. The card frames a crisp HTML title, a center total in the hole, and a legible value+share legend so the reader gets the composition at a glance. Cap at 6 slices; reach for chart_bar when you need to compare two series, or chart_stacked_bar when parts also accumulate across a time axis.

title.description: Chart heading, rendered as crisp HTML above the plot. Name the whole and the unit, e.g. 'Where a $5,000 trading account is allocated'.

caption.description: One-sentence takeaway below the chart. State what the split reveals (the dominant share, an imbalance, a rule of thumb) rather than restating the slices.

eyebrow.description: Optional uppercase kicker above the title, e.g. 'Allocation' or 'Cost breakdown'. Defaults to 'Composition'.

total_label.description: Optional label under the center total in the doughnut hole, e.g. 'Total account' or 'Monthly cost'. Defaults to 'Total'.

value_prefix.description: Optional unit prefix prepended to every value in the legend and center total, e.g. '$'. Leave empty for unit-less or percentage data.

value_suffix.description: Optional unit suffix appended to every value in the legend and center total, e.g. '%' or ' pips'. Leave empty for currency.

labels.description: Slice names, one per value, in the same order as values. Keep them short (1-3 words) so the legend stays on one line.

values.description: One non-negative number per label, in the same order as labels. Length must equal labels.length. Shares are computed from the total automatically.
